newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-INTER'S KANU ON ROAD TO RECOVERY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INTER'S KANU ON ROAD TO RECOVERY.

text.p: Nigerian striker Kanu Nwankwo is making a rapid recovery from heart surgery but his playing future is still in doubt, his Italian serie A side Internazionale were reported saying on Friday.
"The tests done on Kanu until now have all been positive," the Milan club's doctor Piero Volpe told the La Gazzetta dello Sport newspaper.
Volpe said it was not possible to speculate on the future of the African Footballer of the Year before crucial clinical tests in late April or May.
"His progress has stunned even us (doctors) but today there is no certainty that Kanu will return and play," he said.
Kanu, who underwent surgery last November after leading Nigeria to Olympic glory, is following a sports rehabilitation programme in the United States.
